children.text: Conversation 1: Packing Up
Jim's Request
Dad, can I hang out with my friends after lunch?
children.speaker: Jim
children.cn: 爸爸，午饭后我可以和朋友们出去玩吗？
children.notes: hang out with: 和某人出去玩/消磨时间
children.statement: 这句话是在询问许可。
children.explanation: Can I... 是用来征求许可的常用句型。

children.text: Sorry, Jim, you have to pack up your things first.
children.speaker: Dad
children.cn: 抱歉，吉姆，你得先收拾好你的东西。
children.notes: have to: 不得不，必须
children.statement: have to 表示主观意愿。
children.explanation: have to 通常表示客观的必要性或义务。

children.text: But I want to spend time with them before we move.
children.speaker: Jim
children.cn: 但我搬家前想和他们待在一起。
children.notes: spend time with: 和某人共度时光
children.statement: spend time with 意思是浪费时间。
children.explanation: spend time with 的意思是和某人共度时光。

children.text: Dad's Instructions
I know, but we need to get ready before the movers come.
children.speaker: Dad
children.cn: 我知道，但在搬家工人来之前我们需要做好准备。
children.notes: get ready: 准备好
children.statement: movers 指的是搬家工人。
children.explanation: mover 是 move (搬家) 的派生词，指搬家公司的人员。

children.text: Can you sort your things into those boxes?
children.speaker: Dad
children.cn: 你能把你的东西分类放进那些盒子里吗？
children.notes: sort... into...: 把……分类放入……
children.statement: sort 在这里是整理分类的意思。
children.explanation: sort 作为动词，意为分类、整理。

children.text: OK. After that, could I go out?
children.speaker: Jim
children.cn: 好的。那之后，我可以出去吗？
children.notes: could I: 比 can I 更礼貌的请求方式
children.statement: could 比 can 语气更委婉。
children.explanation: 在请求许可时，使用 could 会显得更加礼貌。

children.text: Yes. Remember to write "Jim's bedroom" on each box!
children.speaker: Dad
children.cn: 可以。记得在每个盒子上写上“吉姆的卧室”！
children.notes: Remember to do: 记得去做某事
children.statement: Remember to write 意思是记得写。
children.explanation: Remember to do sth. 表示记得去做某事（还没做）。

children.text: No problem, Dad.
children.speaker: Jim
children.cn: 没问题，爸爸。
children.notes: No problem: 没问题
children.statement: No problem 常用于回应请求。
children.explanation: No problem 是口语中表示同意或没问题的常用语。

children.text: Conversation 2: New House
Jim & Dad: Keeping Fish & Photos
I love our new house.
children.speaker: Jim
children.cn: 我喜欢我们的新房子。

children.text: The living room is so big!
children.speaker: Jim
children.cn: 客厅太大了！

children.text: Could we keep some fish here?
children.speaker: Jim
children.cn: 我们可以在这儿养些鱼吗？
children.notes: keep fish: 养鱼
children.statement: keep 在这里是保持的意思。
children.explanation: keep 在这里是“饲养”的意思。

children.text: Well, Jim, that's a lot of work.
children.speaker: Dad
children.cn: 嗯，吉姆，那可是很多工作。

children.text: Can you take care of them every day?
children.speaker: Dad
children.cn: 你能每天照顾它们吗？
children.notes: take care of: 照顾
children.statement: take care of 意思是照顾。
children.explanation: take care of 是固定短语，意为照顾。

children.text: Yes!
children.speaker: Jim
children.cn: 是的！

children.text: OK. Now, could you please help me hang up the photos?
children.speaker: Dad
children.cn: 好的。现在，你能帮我把照片挂起来吗？
children.notes: hang up: 挂起

children.text: Sure.
children.speaker: Jim
children.cn: 当然。

children.text: Helen & Peter: Flowers & Inviting Friends
Our balcony is so big and gets a lot of sunshine.
children.speaker: Helen
children.cn: 我们的阳台很大，而且阳光充足。
children.notes: balcony: 阳台

children.text: Can I grow some flowers there?
children.speaker: Helen
children.cn: 我可以在那儿种些花吗？
children.notes: grow: 种植

children.text: Yes, you can. That's a great idea, Helen!
children.speaker: Mum
children.cn: 是的，你可以。那是个好主意，海伦！

children.text: Mum, can I invite my friends to our new house?
children.speaker: Peter
children.cn: 妈妈，我可以邀请我的朋友来我们的新房子吗？
children.notes: invite: 邀请

children.text: Yes, Peter, but help clean up first.
children.speaker: Mum
children.cn: 可以，彼得，但先帮忙打扫一下。
children.notes: clean up: 打扫，清理

children.text: Could you please sweep the floor? I'll clean the bathroom.
children.speaker: Mum
children.cn: 你能扫一下地吗？我去打扫浴室。
children.notes: sweep the floor: 扫地

children.text: OK, Mum.
children.speaker: Peter
children.cn: 好的，妈妈。

children.text: The Announcement
Guess what! Grandpa and Grandma are visiting us this weekend!
children.cn: 你们猜怎么着！爷爷和奶奶这周末要来看我们！
children.statement: 爷爷奶奶打算下个月来拜访。
children.explanation: 对话中明确说是 'this weekend'（这周末），而不是下个月。因此陈述是错误的。

children.text: Oh, great!
children.cn: 噢，太棒了！
children.statement: 听到这个消息，吉姆感到非常高兴。
children.explanation: 吉姆说 'Oh, great!'，表示听到这个消息非常高兴。陈述正确。
children.speaker: Jim

children.text: I can't wait to show them our new house!
children.cn: 我等不及要向他们展示我们的新房子了！
children.statement: 'can't wait to do sth' 的意思是“等不及要做某事”。
children.explanation: 'can't wait to do sth' 是常用短语，表示迫不及待、等不及做某事。陈述正确。
children.speaker: Peter
Dad

children.text: Grandma Clean
Yes, but now we need to get ready for their arrival. Can you help me clean up their room?
children.cn: 是的，但现在我们需要为他们的到来做好准备。你能帮我打扫一下他们的房间吗？
children.statement: 妈妈在请求帮助准备房间迎接爷爷奶奶。
children.explanation: 妈妈询问 'Can you help me clean up their room?' 寻求帮忙打扫。陈述正确。

children.text: But their room is already clean!
children.cn: 但是他们的房间已经很干净了！
children.statement: 彼得认为不需要打扫，因为房间已经很干净了。
children.explanation: 彼得提出房间已经是干净的（'already clean'），不解为何需要再次打扫。陈述正确。

children.text: Well, it's not "grandma clean" yet!
children.cn: 好吧，这还没达到“奶奶级别的干净”呢！
children.statement: 'yet' 常用于否定句或疑问句末尾，表示“还（未）”。
children.explanation: 在否定句 'not... yet' 中，yet 意为“还”，强调目前尚未达到某个标准。陈述正确。

children.text: Oh, OK.
children.cn: 噢，好吧。
children.statement: 彼得拒绝了妈妈的打扫请求。
children.explanation: 彼得最后说 'Oh, OK' 表示顺从和答应打扫。因此陈述是错误的。
children.speaker: Peter
Mum
Peter
Mum

children.text: Room Setup
Jim, can you help me put the new clock on the wall? I bought it for Grandpa to see the time.
children.cn: 吉姆，你能帮我把新钟表挂在墙上吗？我买它是为了让爷爷看时间。
children.statement: 爸爸买钟表是为了给奶奶看时间。
children.explanation: 爸爸说 'bought it for Grandpa'，是为了给爷爷（Grandpa）看时间，而不是给奶奶。因此陈述是错误的。

children.text: Sure, Dad.
children.cn: 没问题，爸爸。
children.statement: 吉姆欣然同意了爸爸的请求。
children.explanation: 吉姆说 'Sure, Dad' 表示乐意并同意帮忙。陈述正确。
children.speaker: Jim
Dad

children.text: Helen, can you move this chair to their room? Grandpa likes reading books in front of the window.
children.cn: 海伦，你能把这把椅子搬到他们的房间吗？爷爷喜欢在窗前看书。
children.statement: 爷爷喜欢在门后看书。
children.explanation: 对话中明确指出 'in front of the window'，是窗前，而不是门后。因此陈述是错误的。

children.text: No problem, Dad. Can I put some flowers by the window?
children.cn: 没问题，爸爸。我能在窗边放些花吗？
children.statement: 'by the window' 的意思是“在窗户旁边”。
children.explanation: 介词 'by' 在此处意为“在……旁边”，'by the window' 表示在窗户旁。陈述正确。
children.speaker: Helen
Dad

children.text: Flower Shopping
Yes, good idea! Grandma loves flowers.
children.cn: 好主意！奶奶喜欢花。
children.statement: 爸爸支持海伦在窗边放花的想法，因为奶奶喜欢花。
children.explanation: 爸爸说 'Yes, good idea! Grandma loves flowers'，说明奶奶爱花，海伦的提议很好。陈述正确。

children.text: Mum, could you take me to the flower shop later?
children.cn: 妈妈，你过会儿能带我去花店吗？
children.statement: 海伦希望妈妈立刻带她去花店。
children.explanation: 海伦用的是 'later'（待会儿/过会儿），而不是立刻。因此陈述是错误的。

children.text: No problem. Let's go after lunch.
children.cn: 没问题。我们午饭后去吧。
children.statement: 妈妈决定在午饭前带海伦去花店。
children.explanation: 妈妈说 'Let's go after lunch'（我们午饭后去吧），而不是午饭前。因此陈述是错误的。
children.speaker: Mum
Helen
Dad

tree.text: Going Home for the Spring Festival

children.text: The Journey
"It's almost the Spring Festival. Can we go to Hainan for the holiday, Dad?"
children.cn: “快过春节了。爸爸，我们能去海南度假吗？”
children.statement: 孩子询问爸爸是否能在春节去海南度假。
children.explanation: 句子中表达了询问去海南度假的想法。陈述正确。

children.text: "Not this time," Dad answered with a smile. "We're going to your mum's hometown!"
children.cn: “这次不行，”爸爸微笑着回答。“我们要去你妈妈的故乡！”
children.statement: 他们决定去海南度假。
children.explanation: 爸爸说 'Not this time'（这次不行），他们要去的是妈妈的故乡（mum's hometown），不是海南。因此陈述是错误的。

children.text: Soon the day of our family trip came. We got up very early in the morning to catch the train.
children.cn: 很快，我们家庭旅行的日子到了。我们早上起得很早去赶火车。
children.statement: 'get up' 过去式为 'got up'，'to catch the train' 不定式作目的状语。
children.explanation: 动词 get 的过去式是 got；to catch the train 是动词不定式，在句中作目的状语，表示“为了赶火车”。陈述正确。

children.text: The train journey took more than five hours, and then we changed to a bus to get to my grandparents' village in the afternoon.
children.cn: 火车旅程花了五个多小时，然后我们在下午转乘公共汽车前往我祖父母的村庄。
children.statement: 坐火车旅行花了不到五个小时。
children.explanation: 文中提到 'took more than five hours'（花了五个多小时），而不是不到五个小时。因此陈述是错误的。

children.text: The Arrival
At the end of the road, I saw Grandpa and my little cousin standing in the cold wind waiting for us.
children.cn: 在路的尽头，我看到爷爷和小表弟站在寒风中等我们。
children.statement: 爷爷和表弟在暖和的屋里等着他们。
children.explanation: 他们站在寒风（cold wind）中等待，因此是在户外。陈述是错误的。

children.text: We walked quickly to greet them. Grandpa helped us pull the heavy luggage into the house.
children.cn: 我们快步走过去迎接他们。爷爷帮我们把沉重的行李拉进屋里。
children.statement: 爷爷帮助他们搬了行李。
children.explanation: 爷爷帮助他们把沉重的行李拉进了屋里（'helped us pull the heavy luggage'）。陈述正确。

children.text: "Ah, home again!" said Mum with a smile on her face.
children.cn: “啊，又到家了！”妈妈脸上带着微笑说道。
children.statement: 回到故乡，妈妈感到很伤心。
children.explanation: 妈妈是带着微笑（'with a smile'）说 'home again!'，感到温暖亲切，并非伤心。因此陈述是错误的。

children.text: Dinner Time
Grandma, my aunt, and my uncle were busy cooking dinner in the kitchen. They were very happy to see us.
children.cn: 奶奶、婶婶和叔叔正忙着在厨房做饭。他们看到我们非常高兴。
children.statement: 'be busy doing sth' 意为“忙于做某事”。
children.explanation: 固定搭配 'be busy doing sth' 表示忙着做某事，这里是 'were busy cooking'。陈述正确。

children.text: "Could you bring Wenwen her favourite snacks?" Grandma asked Grandpa.
children.cn: “你能给雯雯拿她最喜欢的零食吗？”奶奶问爷爷。
children.statement: 奶奶请求爷爷给雯雯拿零食。
children.explanation: 奶奶问爷爷 'Could you bring Wenwen her favourite snacks?'，属于委婉请求。陈述正确。

children.text: I shared the snacks with my cousin and told Grandpa about school. He was happy to hear I was doing well at school.
children.cn: 我和表弟分享了零食，并跟爷爷讲了学校里的事。听到我在学校表现很好，他很高兴。
children.statement: 作者独自吃完了所有零食，没有分享。
children.explanation: 文中写到 'I shared the snacks with my cousin'（我和我的表弟分享了零食）。因此陈述是错误的。

children.text: We then enjoyed all the delicious food. "Mm, the familiar taste of home!" said Mum.
children.cn: 然后我们享用了所有美味的食物。“嗯，这熟悉的家的味道！”妈妈说。
children.statement: 'delicious' 意为“美味的”，'familiar' 意为“熟悉的”。
children.explanation: 这两个词的中文意思分别是：delicious美味的，familiar熟悉的。陈述正确。

children.text: During the dinner, my uncle told us some jokes and we had a good laugh.
children.cn: 晚餐期间，我叔叔给我们讲了一些笑话，我们开怀大笑。
children.statement: 晚餐时气氛非常沉闷严肃。
children.explanation: 叔叔讲了笑话，大家开怀大笑（'had a good laugh'），说明气氛很欢乐愉快，不沉闷。因此陈述是错误的。

children.text: The Departure
Several days later when we were leaving, Grandma held my hands and asked us, "Will you come home more often?"
children.cn: 几天后我们要走的时候，奶奶握着我的手问我们：“你们能常回家看看吗？”
children.statement: 奶奶舍不得他们走，希望他们多回家。
children.explanation: 奶奶拉着手问 'Will you come home more often?'，体现了对晚辈依依不舍与期盼。陈述正确。

children.text: Mum nodded, with tears in her eyes.
children.cn: 妈妈点点头，眼里含着泪水。
children.statement: 妈妈在摇头表示拒绝。
children.explanation: 妈妈是 'nodded'（点头），而不是摇头。因此陈述是错误的。

children.text: Warm Welcome & Community Party
children.cn: 热情欢迎与社区派对

children.text: Welcome!
children.cn: 欢迎！
children.statement: 信件开篇向新居民表达了热烈的欢迎。
children.explanation: 文中第一句话就是 'Welcome!'。陈述正确。

children.text: We're excited to have you in our community.
children.cn: 我们很高兴你能加入我们的社区。
children.statement: 社区对新成员的到来感到非常高兴。
children.explanation: 文中写道 'We're excited to have you in our community'。陈述正确。

children.text: We hope you'll feel at home here.
children.cn: 我们希望你在这里能像在家里一样自在。
children.statement: 社区希望新居民在这里感到拘束和陌生。
children.explanation: feel at home 意思是“感觉像在家里一样宾至如归”。陈述错误。

children.text: Your arrival brings joy to us.
children.cn: 你的到来给我们带来了欢乐。
children.statement: 新居民的到来给社区带来了欢乐。
children.explanation: 文中写道 'Your arrival brings joy to us'。陈述正确。

children.text: We would like to invite you to the community party at 2 p.m. on Sunday.
children.cn: 我们想邀请你参加周日下午2点的社区派对。
children.statement: 社区派对将在周六上午举行。
children.explanation: 信中明确说明是 'at 2 p.m. on Sunday'（周日下午2点）。陈述错误。

children.text: You can find us on the first floor of Apartment Block A.
children.keywords: find us, first floor, Apartment Block A
children.cn: 你可以在A栋公寓楼的一楼找到我们。
children.statement: 活动地点在A栋公寓楼的一楼。
children.explanation: 文中指出 'on the first floor of Apartment Block A'。陈述正确。

children.text: Friendly Atmosphere & Helpful Hands
children.cn: 友好氛围与乐于助人

children.text: In our community, everyone is friendly and always ready to give a hand.
children.keywords: everyone friendly, ready to give a hand
children.cn: 在我们社区里，每个人都很友好，并且总是乐于助人。
children.statement: 社区里的居民都非常冷漠，不愿提供帮助。
children.explanation: 文中说每个人都很友好且乐于助人（ready to give a hand）。陈述错误。

children.text: If you have any questions or need help, feel free to ask.
children.keywords: questions, need help, feel free to ask
children.cn: 如果你有任何问题或需要帮助，请随时提出。
children.statement: 如果有任何疑问或需要帮助，新居民可以随时询问。
children.explanation: feel free to ask 意为“随时欢迎提问”。陈述正确。

children.text: See you soon!
children.cn: 回头见！
children.statement: 信末向新居民热情道别并期待尽快相见。
children.explanation: See you soon! 表达期待很快见面的友好问候。陈述正确。

children.text: Reason & Request for Help
children.cn: 装饰原因与请求帮助

children.text: It was fun to decorate your room last month.
children.cn: 上个月给你装修房间真有趣。
children.statement: 张鹏上个月曾帮约翰装饰过房间。
children.explanation: 文中写道 'It was fun to decorate your room last month'。陈述正确。

children.text: I share a room with my brother.
children.cn: 我和我哥哥合住一个房间。
children.statement: 张鹏一个人独住一间大卧室。
children.explanation: 文中明确写到 'I share a room with my brother'（和兄弟合住）。陈述错误。

children.text: We want to decorate it too.
children.cn: 我们也想装饰一下它。
children.statement: 张鹏和他的兄弟也想把他们的房间重新装饰一下。
children.explanation: 文中提到 'We want to decorate it too'。陈述正确。

children.text: Can you help us?
children.cn: 你能帮帮我们吗？
children.statement: 张鹏在邮件中请求约翰提供帮助。
children.explanation: Can you help us? 表达向对方寻求帮助。陈述正确。

children.text: Current Walls & New Color Plan
children.cn: 当前墙面状况与换色计划

children.text: Right now, the walls are blue.
children.cn: 现在，墙壁是蓝色的。
children.statement: 房间目前的墙壁颜色是绿色的。
children.explanation: 信中指出 'the walls are blue'（墙是蓝色的）。陈述错误。

children.text: There are cute animals on them, but the animals look too young for us.
children.cn: 上面有一些可爱的动物图案，但这些动物对我们来说显得太幼稚了。
children.statement: 张鹏认为墙上的动物图案显得过于低幼了。
children.explanation: 文中写道 'the animals look too young for us'。陈述正确。

children.text: We want to cover the animals and paint the walls light green.
children.keywords: cover animals, paint walls, light green
children.cn: 我们想把那些动物遮盖住，把墙刷成浅绿色。
children.statement: 他们打算把墙壁重新刷成浅绿色。
children.explanation: 文中写到 'paint the walls light green'。陈述正确。

children.text: What do you think about the colour?
children.cn: 你觉得这个颜色怎么样？
children.statement: 张鹏向约翰征询关于浅绿色的看法。
children.explanation: What do you think about the colour? 用于征询对方对颜色的意见。陈述正确。

children.text: Sunday Meeting, Brushes & Photos
children.cn: 周日相聚、画刷与相片墙

children.text: On Sunday, we can meet at the paint shop near the shopping centre and choose the paint together.
children.keywords: Sunday, meet, paint shop, shopping centre, choose paint
children.cn: 周日，我们可以在购物中心附近的油漆店碰头，一起挑选油漆。
children.statement: 他们约定周日在购物中心附近的油漆店碰面。
children.explanation: 文中写道 'meet at the paint shop near the shopping centre'。陈述正确。

children.text: Then we can paint the room with my brother.
children.cn: 然后我们可以和我哥哥一起粉刷房间。
children.statement: 选好油漆后，他们打算一起动手粉刷房间。
children.explanation: 文中写到 'Then we can paint the room with my brother'。陈述正确。

children.text: I loved the brushes we used for your room.
children.keywords: loved brushes, used for your room
children.cn: 我很喜欢我们给你粉刷房间时用的那些刷子。
children.statement: 张鹏觉得上次给约翰刷房间用的刷子很好用。
children.explanation: 文中提到 'I loved the brushes we used for your room'。陈述正确。

children.text: Can you bring them?
children.cn: 你能把它们带过来吗？
children.statement: 张鹏请求约翰把那些刷子带过来。
children.explanation: Can you bring them? 明确请求对方把刷子带来。陈述正确。

children.text: After painting, could you help choose some photos to hang on the walls?
children.keywords: after painting, help choose photos, hang on walls
children.cn: 粉刷完之后，你能帮我选一些照片挂在墙上吗？
children.statement: 刷完墙后，张鹏希望约翰帮忙挑选挂在墙上的照片。
children.explanation: 文中写到 'help choose some photos to hang on the walls'。陈述正确。

children.text: Let me know what you think.
children.keywords: let me know what you think
children.cn: 让我知道你的想法。
children.statement: 张鹏在信末期待约翰回复想法。
children.explanation: Let me know what you think 用于期待对方的回信与想法。陈述正确。

children.text: Marilla's Illness and the Doctor's News
Background and Return
Anne was adopted by Marilla when she was little.
children.cn: 安妮小的时候被玛丽拉收养。
children.notes: was adopted by = 被……收养（被动语态）
children.statement: was adopted by 表示被动语态，意为“被……收养”。
children.explanation: 句中使用 was adopted by 结构表示一般过去时的被动语态。

children.text: They lived happily together on a farm called Green Gables.
children.cn: 他们在一个叫做绿山墙的农场里快乐地生活在一起。
children.notes: called Green Gables = 叫做绿山墙的（过去分词作后置定语）
children.statement: 农场叫作“绿山墙”。
children.explanation: called Green Gables 作后置定语修饰 a farm。

children.text: Now Anne is going to a university out of town, but Marilla gets sick ...
children.cn: 现在安妮要去城外的大学读书，但玛丽拉生病了……
children.notes: out of town = 城外；get sick = 生病
children.statement: 玛丽拉身体非常健康，毫无问题。
children.explanation: 文中明确说 Marilla gets sick（玛丽拉生病了）。
children.keywords: university, out of town, gets sick

children.text: Anne came back and found Marilla sitting by the kitchen table.
children.cn: 安妮回来了，发现玛丽拉坐在厨房餐桌旁。
children.notes: find sb doing sth = 发现某人正在做某事
children.statement: find sb doing sth 结构中，现在分词作宾语补足语。
children.explanation: sitting 在句中充当宾语 Marilla 的宾语补足语。
children.keywords: came back, sitting by kitchen table

children.text: She looked tired.
children.cn: 她看起来很疲倦。
children.notes: looked tired = 看起来疲惫（系表结构）
children.statement: looked 在这里是实义动词“看”。
children.explanation: looked 是系动词，意为“看起来”，后接形容词 tired 作表语。

children.text: Anxious Dialogue
"Are you OK, Marilla?"
children.speaker: Anne
children.cn: “你还好吗，玛丽拉？”
children.notes: Are you OK? = 你没事吧/还好吗？
children.statement: 安妮在询问玛丽拉的身体状况。
children.explanation: Are you OK? 是关切询问身体或状态的常用表达。

children.text: "I saw the doctor," Marilla said sadly.
children.speaker: Marilla
children.cn: “我看医生了，”玛丽拉伤心地说。
children.notes: saw the doctor = 看了医生；sadly = 悲伤地
children.statement: sadly 是形容词，修饰名词。
children.explanation: sadly 是副词，用来修饰动词 said。

children.text: "But it's no good talking about it, Anne. Can you get me a cup of tea?"
children.speaker: Marilla
children.cn: “但谈论这事没什么用，安妮。你能给我倒杯茶吗？”
children.notes: it's no good doing sth = 做某事没有用
children.statement: it's no good doing sth 意思是“做某事是没用的”。
children.explanation: it's no good doing sth 是固定句型，意为做某事毫无益处。
children.keywords: no good talking, cup of tea

children.text: "Could you tell me what the doctor said?" Anne asked softly as she brought tea to Marilla.
children.speaker: Anne
children.cn: “你能告诉我医生说了什么吗？”安妮端茶给玛丽拉时轻声问道。
children.notes: what the doctor said = 宾语从句；softly = 温柔轻声地
children.statement: what the doctor said 是 tell 的直接宾语从句。
children.explanation: what the doctor said 充当 tell 的宾语从句，使用陈述语序。

children.text: The Risk of Losing Green Gables
The Threat of Blindness and Selling the Farm
"He said I must give up all reading, sewing, and farming, or I will go blind."
children.speaker: Marilla
children.cn: “他说我必须放弃所有的阅读、缝纫和农活，否则我就会失明。”
children.notes: give up = 放弃；go blind = 失明
children.statement: go blind 中的 go 是系动词，意为“变得……”。
children.explanation: go 作系动词接形容词 blind，表示进入某种不良状态（变瞎）。
children.keywords: give up, sewing, farming, go blind

children.text: "Marilla, don't think of it," said Anne.
children.speaker: Anne
children.cn: “玛丽拉，别想这个了，”安妮说。
children.notes: don't think of it = 祈使句否定形式
children.statement: 这是一句祈使句的否定形式。
children.explanation: Don't + 动词原形构成否定祈使句。

children.text: "There is still hope."
children.speaker: Anne
children.cn: “仍然还有希望。”
children.notes: There is = 有；hope = 希望
children.statement: 这句话表达了安妮乐观积极的态度。
children.explanation: There is still hope 意为“还有希望”，传递了鼓励与信念。

children.text: "I don't know," said Marilla.
children.speaker: Marilla
children.cn: “我不知道，”玛丽拉说。
children.notes: I don't know = 我不知道
children.statement: 玛丽拉此时充满了信心。
children.explanation: 玛丽拉感到迷茫和沮丧（I don't know）。

children.text: "I'm afraid I have to sell Green Gables."
children.speaker: Marilla
children.cn: “恐怕我不得不把绿山墙卖掉了。”
children.notes: be afraid = 恐怕；have to = 不得不
children.statement: 玛丽拉非常渴望卖掉绿山墙农场去环游世界。
children.explanation: 玛丽拉是因为眼睛将要失明无法打理，才无奈考虑卖掉农场。

children.text: Anne was surprised.
children.cn: 安妮感到很惊讶。
children.notes: was surprised = 感到吃惊
children.statement: surprised 在句中作表语，表示人的心理感受。
children.explanation: surprised 是形容词作表语，表示“感到吃惊的”。

children.text: "Oh, Marilla, you can't! It's our home!"
children.speaker: Anne
children.cn: “噢，玛丽拉，你不能这样！这是我们的家！”
children.notes: It's our home = 这是我们的家
children.statement: 安妮完全同意玛丽拉卖掉农场。
children.explanation: 安妮强烈反对卖掉家园（you can't! It's our home!）。

children.text: "What else can I do, Anne? I'm sorry you won't have a home to come to during your university holidays."
children.speaker: Marilla
children.cn: “我还能做什么呢，安妮？很抱歉你在大学放假期间没有家可以回了。”
children.notes: what else = 还有什么；during holidays = 在假期期间
children.statement: during 是介词，表示“在……期间”。
children.explanation: during holidays 意为在大学假期期间。
children.keywords: What else, home to come to, university holidays

children.text: Marilla began to cry.
children.cn: 玛丽拉哭了起来。
children.notes: began to cry = 开始哭泣（begin to do sth.）
children.statement: began 是 begin 的过去式。
children.explanation: begin 的不规则过去式是 began。

children.text: Anne's Choice and Determination
Night Thoughts and Morning Decision
That night, Anne sat in the darkness, alone with her tears and heavy heart.
children.cn: 那天晚上，安妮坐在黑暗中，独自流泪，心情沉重。
children.notes: in the darkness = 在黑暗中；heavy heart = 沉重的心情
children.statement: heavy heart 字面是沉重的心，引申为“沉重悲伤的心情”。
children.explanation: heavy heart 是常用成语表达，表示心情极为沉重。

children.text: But before long, there was a smile on her lips and peace in her heart.
children.cn: 但没过多久，她的嘴角浮现出微笑，内心归于平静。
children.notes: before long = 不久以后；peace = 平静，宁静
children.statement: before long 意思是“不久以后”。
children.explanation: before long 是固定短语，表示“不久之后”。
children.keywords: before long, smile, peace in heart

children.text: The next day, she spoke with Marilla.
children.cn: 第二天，她和玛丽拉谈了谈。
children.notes: spoke with = 与……交谈（speak的过去式）
children.statement: spoke 是 speak 的过去式。
children.explanation: speak 的过去式是 spoke。

children.text: "You mustn't sell Green Gables. I'm going to teach here. I can't leave you alone, Marilla. I'll read to you. We'll be happy together."
children.speaker: Anne
children.cn: “你绝不能卖掉绿山墙。我打算在这里教书。我不能留下你一个人，玛丽拉。我会读给你听。我们会快乐地在一起。”
children.notes: mustn't = 绝不能；leave sb alone = 留下某人独自一人
children.statement: mustn't 表示强烈的禁止，意为“绝不能”。
children.explanation: mustn't 表示“千万不要、绝不能”。
children.keywords: mustn't sell, teach here, leave you alone, read to you

children.text: "Oh, Anne, you can't do that for me."
children.speaker: Marilla
children.cn: “噢，安妮，你不能为了我这样做。”
children.notes: do that for me = 为我做那件事
children.statement: 玛丽拉自私地要求安妮牺牲前途留下来。
children.explanation: 玛丽拉是不希望安妮为了自己放弃读大学的机会。

children.text: "But I want to! Nothing is worse than giving up our home."
children.speaker: Anne
children.cn: “但我愿意！没有什么比放弃我们的家更糟糕的了。”
children.notes: nothing is worse than = 没有什么比……更糟
children.statement: worse 是 bad 的比较级形式。
children.explanation: bad/badly 的比较级是 worse，最高级是 worst。
children.keywords: want to, worse than, giving up home

children.text: "But your dreams ..."
children.speaker: Marilla
children.cn: “但是你的梦想……”
children.notes: dreams = 梦想
children.statement: 玛丽拉担心安妮的梦想无法实现。
children.explanation: 玛丽拉关心安妮的前途和梦想。

children.text: "My dreams are the same: to be a good teacher, and to help you stay healthy. Nobody loves Green Gables as we do. We must keep it."
children.speaker: Anne
children.cn: “我的梦想依然是一样的：成为一名优秀的老师，并帮助你保持健康。没有人像我们这样深爱绿山墙。我们必须保住它。”
children.notes: the same = 相同的；stay healthy = 保持健康；keep it = 守住它
children.statement: 安妮认为照顾玛丽拉和当一名好老师就是她不变的梦想。
children.explanation: 安妮明确说明她的梦想是成为好老师并照顾玛丽拉保持健康。
children.keywords: dreams same, good teacher, stay healthy, keep it

children.text: True Love and Peaceful Dusk
The Neighbour's View and Peaceful Life
Most people, not knowing about Marilla's eyes, thought Anne was foolish.
children.cn: 大多数人不知道玛丽拉眼睛的情况，认为安妮很愚蠢。
children.notes: not knowing about... = 现在分词短语作状语；foolish = 愚蠢的
children.statement: 大多数人理解安妮留下的真正原因。
children.explanation: 大多数人不知道玛丽拉眼疾的事实（not knowing about Marilla's eyes）。

children.text: Mrs Lynde, their neighbour, did not.
children.cn: 他们的邻居林德太太却不这么认为。
children.notes: their neighbour = 同位语；did not = did not think so
children.statement: 林德太太也认为安妮是一个愚蠢的孩子。
children.explanation: 林德太太并不这样认为（did not think Anne was foolish）。

children.text: She often found Anne and Marilla sitting outside their home.
children.cn: 她经常发现安妮和玛丽拉坐在屋外。
children.notes: sitting outside = 坐在外面（宾语补足语）
children.statement: sitting outside 作宾语补足语，修饰 Anne and Marilla。
children.explanation: find sb doing sth 结构中现在分词作宾补。

children.text: They liked sitting there at dusk, when the smell of flowers filled the air.
children.cn: 她们喜欢在黄昏时坐在那里，那时空气中弥漫着花香。
children.notes: at dusk = 在黄昏时；filled the air = 弥漫在空中
children.statement: at dusk 的意思是“在黎明破晓时”。
children.explanation: at dusk 意为“在黄昏时分/傍晚”，而不是黎明。
children.keywords: sitting at dusk, smell of flowers, filled air
